committee: *Presentation Notice for Legislative Certificate No. 376-38 (COR) - Legislative Secretary Senator Sabrina Salas Matanane
title: Håfa Adai, Please join me in presenting Legislative Certificate No. 376-38 (COR), recognizing the recipients of the 2026 Emergency Medical Services (EMS) Provider of the Year Awards and the EMS Life Saving and Significant Achievement Awards during the 2026 EMS Awards Ceremony held in observance of Emergency Medical Services Week 2026. The presentation is scheduled for Thursday, May 21, 2026, at 10:30 a.m. at the Lotte Hotel, Tumon.
